title: Utility Order for The Baton Rouge Water Works Company, d/b/a Baton Rouge Water, ex parte. — Order No. U-37941 accepts the Joint Report and issues the Draft Order filed into the record on August 28, 2026. Commission consideration occurred at the September 16, 2026 Business and Executive Session.

documents.text:
LOUISIANA PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
                                  ORDER NUMBER U-37941

THE BATON ROUGE WATER WORKS COMPANY, D/B/A BATON ROUGE WATER,
                         EX PARTE.

Docket No. U-37941, In re: Formula Rate Plan annual earnings report for test year ending
December 31, 2025.

              (Decided at the September 16, 2026 Business and Executive Session.)


                                            ORDER

Overview and Procedural History

       The Louisiana Public Service Commission (“Commission”), having reviewed and

considered the Joint Report and Draft Order on The Baton Rouge Water Works Company’s

Formula Rate Olan Annual Report Filing for the Test Year Ending December 31, 2025 (“Joint

Report”), submitted by the Louisiana Public Service Commission Staff (“Staff”) and The Baton

Rouge Water Works Company d/b/a Baton Rouge Water (“BRWC” or “Company”), finds the

Joint Report, together with its attached exhibits, to be acceptable and in accordance with the

provisions of the Commission’s Order No. U-37761 dated May 21, 2026, which established the

Company’s current Formula Rate Plan (“FRP”) for test years 2025-2027. The Joint Report was

filed into the record on August 28, 2026.


       The Joint Report indicated that, after adjustments, BRWC earned a Return on Equity Ratio

(“ROE”) that fell below the bandwidth prescribed in the Company’s FRP. Accordingly, a rate

increase is required.


Commission Jurisdiction and Authority


       The Commission exercises jurisdiction over public utilities in Louisiana pursuant to Article
IV, Section 21(B) of the Louisiana Constitution, which provides the following:


               The commission shall regulate all common carriers and public
               utilities and have such other regulatory authority as provided by
               law. It shall adopt and enforce reasonable rules, regulations,
               and procedures necessary for the discharge of its duties, and shall
               have other powers and perform other duties as provided by law.

       Pursuant to its constitutional authority, the Commission issued Order No. U-37761, which

established BRWC’s current FRP. The Company’s FRP provided for a ROE bandwidth with a

lower endpoint of 9.00%, an upper endpoint of 10.00%, and a midpoint of 9.50%. Under the FRP,


                                                                               Order No. U-37941
                                                                                          Page 1
 if a test year’s adjusted ROE is less than 9.00% or greater than 10.00%, BRWC’s FRP revenue is

to be increased or decreased, respectively, by the amount necessary to increase or decrease the

ROE to reach the midpoint of 9.50%.



Commission Consideration

       This matter was considered at the Commission’s September 16, 2026 Business and

Executive Session. On motion of Vice Chairman Coussan, seconded by Commissioner Lewis, and

unanimously adopted, the Commission voted to accept the Joint Report and issue the Draft Order

filed into the record on August 28, 2026.



THEREFORE, IT IS ORDERED:
       The Commission accepts the Joint Report and Draft Order filed into the record on August

28, 2026, and issue the draft order.



This order is effective immediately


BY ORDER OF THE COMMISSION
BATON ROUGE, LOUISIANA
October 12, 2026
